text: [After watching his wife and daughter killed|who_suffers|the grieving] on a snowy road, the New York composer John Russell [rents a vast Seattle mansion|trigger|making a new home] that has stood empty for twelve years. Each morning brings a loud banging, taps run by themselves, a drowned boy appears in the bathtub, and a boarded-up door opens on [a hidden attic bedroom|images|the house and its rooms]. A seance voice names itself Joseph Carmichael, a sickly child [murdered by his father|wrong|harm done to children] for an inheritance and secretly replaced.
